basic_info.description: Basked in natural light, this sophisticated south-facing 2BR residence enjoys ever-changing images of the City from sunrise to sunset. Join the international community at The Pacific, the premier Pacific Heights full-service, ultra-luxury condominium building in an A+ northside neighborhood. Residence 502 was polished for the owners by the design team at Jeff Schlarb Design. Every detail was lovingly elevated with a unifying aesthetic. Wood floors throughout, in a stunning chevron pattern in the principal rooms. Curated wall coverings, drapes & light fixtures, custom closets, comprehensive home automation system are part of this exceptional offering. A truly superb floor plan offers separation of bedroom suites, excellent circulation for socializing and laundry room doubling as pantry. All rooms face south. The European kitchen's statuario marble island, with counter seating, invitingly faces the view. The LR allows for sofa viewing of the nearby architecturally significant synagogue as well as facing the custom cabinetry for TV, books and objects. Approx. 11' ceilings with floor-to-ceiling windows; AC. Five-star building amenities, 24/7 door staff, gym, view observatory & terrace, guest suite, tree-studded central lawn. One car sbs parking. Elevators, bike room.
